phase_prompt.summary: The group stands as the verified kernel of the simulation, visually distinct in their clarity and emotional weight amidst a procedural world. They are the focus of the camera's empathy.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: An intense, photorealistic close-up of The Chosen and Beloved, capturing the micro-details of skin texture and the subtle, internal plasma glow of their vitality. They stand calm within a chaotic simulation environment, shielded by a faint, transparent vector field distortion. The lighting is dramatic and moody, emphasizing the contours of their faces and the 'obsidian' depth of their eyes. The background is a blurred 'data-glass' landscape of the simulation boundary. Shot on 35mm film stock with a shallow depth of field, emphasizing emotional authenticity and narrative gravity.
